title: DSH Workload Report — effort and token usage, with a client-ready HTML report
tagline: Workload and token usage by date, workspace and model — plus a self-contained HTML report you can send to a client.
description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: active time and token usage in one view, by date, workspace, model and session. Calendar heatmap, time-of-day analysis, model speed, TTFT and estimated cost; a client-ready self-contained HTML report; an optional AI usage profile; optional multi-device sync; 8 interface languages. Read-only and local by default.
